# Verifies `dump lowered --list` succeeds for every shipping platform.
# InlinePure runs always-on (Plan G); fyne also opts into NoStdlibWrappers.

sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoListLambdas,NoInlineComponents'
stdout 'passes: PlatformExtensionBody . NoListLambdas . InlinePure . NoInlineComponents'

sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform fyne --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoListLambdas,NoReactivity,NoStdlibWrappers,NoInlineComponents,NoDeclarative'
stdout 'passes: PlatformExtensionBody . NoListLambdas . InlinePure . NoInlineComponents . NoReactivity . NoDeclarative'

sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform html --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoAsyncReactive,NoListLambdas,NoReactivity,NoStdlibWrappers'
stdout 'passes: PlatformExtensionBody . NoAsyncReactive . NoListLambdas . InlinePure . NoReactivity'

sngl dump lowered --lang none --platform html --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoAsyncReactive,NoReactivity,NoStdlibWrappers'
stdout 'passes: PlatformExtensionBody . NoAsyncReactive . InlinePure . NoReactivity'

sngl dump lowered --lang kotlin --platform android --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoInlineComponents'
stdout 'passes: PlatformExtensionBody . InlinePure . NoInlineComponents'

# Unknown pass name surfaces a non-zero exit.
! sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --after NoBogus main.sngl

-- main.sngl --
component main {
    text(value="hello")
}
